headline: Western Washington host the side that beat Simon Fraser
dek: Cal Poly Pomona beat Simon Fraser at home in September and again in November, and travel next to Western Washington. The hosts have lost twice in twenty-one matches and conceded six goals across all of them on the way to the top of the conference table.
displaced_by: Simon Fraser lost at Cal Poly Pomona, who now visit Western Washington, so the standing dek's 'closing the season' no longer holds

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Simon Fraser scored more than any other programme and still finished below Western Washington: in this conference the goals did not decide the table.

wire.line: Tenley Leffler made 107 saves for Montana State Billings, a side that won twice all season.
